en: Yes, thank you, Reijiher. Now, if you'll excuse me.
Guild 1-2
Lehan
Fein...
Master Lehan. It's been a long time.
What brings you here? It really has been a long time. Are you going back to the island?
No, I'm still on my travels.
I see... Zig's youngest granddaughter is still on the island, isn't she? Go home to her once in a while.
Yes, I will.
Things have been restless around the Empire lately... Some Guild Masters even foretell a great calamity.
There's no knowing what will happen these days. If you have a place to return to, go back while you can.
...Yes.
Hahaha, I've started preaching. But I'm glad to see you looking well.
Come by again. Next time, I'd like to hear all about your travels.
Yes, Master Lehan. Well then, I'll take my leave.
Oh, Fein. Do go and see the Grand Master in Basel once in a while.
Chair 1
Chair 2
Greza
Fein... is it.
Yes, Master Greza.
I'd like to say welcome... but we can't talk long. I'm leaving for the Grand Lodge now.
For the Grand Lodge? Why?
A terrible prophecy has appeared... I must report it to the Grand Master at once...
Master Greza, what is this prophecy?
That legend may rise again across a thousand years...
That alone should tell you... what sort of thing is coming...
It can't be...
No... it can, and my prophecy clearly points to it.
I must hurry...
I won't be coming back here. Once I've reported to the Grand Master, I'm fleeing south.
If we're still alive, we'll meet again, Fein.
A prophecy...
Guild 2
Desk
Young Mage
Fein, long time no see.
Rand. Have you been well?
Rand
Yeah. What brings you here today? If it's the Grand Master you want, sorry, he's out.
Out? Where did he go?
Seems he went to the lodge in Lefkas.
Lefkas? But why would the Grand Master need to go there himself?
Well... he said something about moving the Demon Stone to the Grand Lodge.
The one the previous Grand Master received from Marquis Zern in the east?
That's it. Apparently a prophecy said it was bad to keep it there.
Hmm...
I don't know any more than that. Some of the Masters don't like to say much.
...... I suppose so...
Say, Fein. You can stay a while today, can't you?
No sense talking standing up in a place like this. It's a little early, but let's talk over a drink.
I don't get to see you often. Why not?
Yes, let's.
Fein!
Oh, Rand. What is it?
Well, I was curious what you two talked about. What did the Elder say?
He seemed very concerned about the prophecy.
I see... And what do you think?
Chaos is breaking out here and there. It's scattered, and to me none of it seems connected.
I can't tell whether it will drag in this Guild either.
But if the worst happens, you'll all be here. I'm not worried.
True... As long as we don't know how the chaos is connected, worrying too much could even do harm...
Say, Fein. Isn't it about time you settled down?
Someone has to do your work, but by now someone else could take over.
Besides, it'd be reassuring to have you back here. I'm sure the Elder wants that too.
No... there's still something I have to do.
Empire and Alberic
Dead Warlock
Damn it!!! How could this happen?!
Those bastards... the Grand Master?!
Master!!
Fein... the Demon Stone was taken... a single imperial knight... buried everyone in an instant...
That man had a demon sword... one no human should ever hold...
Fein... it seems the legend of the Demon Stone was true...
...Take it back... the Demon Stone, from that man...
Stop the prophecy...
Empire and Alberic (Alberic
Knight
How dare you... the lodge...
Hmph... one of the Guild? I grew tired of cutting down mages in that last fight.
You bastard!!
My sword says it feels ill from drinking too much of your filthy blood...
I leave this man to you.
Sir, Lord Alberic.
You bastard! Running away?!
Hmph, the likes of you aren't worth troubling Lord Alberic over.
You lot... don't expect a single one of you to leave alive!
Assassins
Who's there?!
So it's you lot...
Silent again, I see... But this time won't go like the last.
Assassins (After Battle)
Who gave the order?
You're the Empire's dogs, aren't you?
The Empire... will restore the glory of the Crimson Moon King once more...
We won't let the likes of you get in the way...
Holy City Falls
We're badly outnumbered... no matter how many I cut down, there's no end!
...That's... Serenis?!
Can't you see her? ＄＄＄＄＄＄!
Over there!
Serenis!!
You there, what business have you with Lady Serenis?!
It's me! Recognize me! Serenis!!
Do you want to die?! Insolent wretch!
It can't be... that legend...
Only the chosen, those who have received a holy blessing, can find their way here... Warrior... so you are one of the chosen...
...I don't know whether I was chosen... But I am certainly being guided.
I see... What is your name?
My name is Fein Lu Lugus.
Then, Fein, come here...
You have quite a strong power... I can sense considerable talent.
Fein... the battles ahead of you will surely be extremely hard...{n}
That is true not only of you but of all whom the Angel guides: to fight evil powers, you will need a strong will.
For the enemy targets the weakness in people's hearts. But you must not give in to it.
Diana-sama... do you know the true nature of this evil power?
No. What the Angel does not know, I do not know either.
But I do know the wickedness of the devils who now target this world. And how hard it is for people to fight them...
I see... I too sense an evil presence.
And I hope it will not become the legend come again...
Yes, exactly so. But something has already begun to move. Please, always stay on your guard.
All I can do is speak with you like this, but I am prepared to stand united with everyone and fight evil.
Fein... as one under the Angel's protection, let us drive away the darkness of this world.
Yes, I understand...
You!
Diana-sama!
Ah, Fein... the Demon Stone has been stolen.
The Demon Stone...?! So you had the Demon Stone, Diana-sama...
More importantly, Fein... what I feared is about to happen. They intend to revive the Heavenly Dragon.
If all the Demon Stones are gathered, the world may be destroyed...
Fein... please, protect the world together with the Angel...
Yes... I understand... Diana-sama...
Was I too late?
Damn it... if only I'd gotten here sooner...
Magic Beast
Stop it! Why are you doing this?!
...Don't get in my way.
Stop this foolishness. Why would a child like you do something like this?
I won't lose to the likes of you...
...Don't get in my way. You... have I met you somewhere?
You're the one who attacked the Forest of the Holy Mother, aren't you?
Hmph... so what if I did? Gonna beat me up?
Ngh!
Hmph... so what if I did?{n}
Stop this foolishness. Why would a child like you do something like this?!
Irene?
Oh, Fein... Long time no see...
Weren't you at the tower?
Yeah... but an angel showed up and told me to be a hero, so...
I left the tower...
Irene, but that outfit...
Haha, d-don't worry about it. This is just a spell that went wrong...
I'm sorry. I just couldn't find the time to come back.
No, it's fine.
You still haven't found my sister, have you...
But... I'll find her, I swear. I haven't given up yet.
Yeah...
I left the tower, so I'll help too...
Let's look for her together.
Thank you... Irene.
Irene (Second Meeting)
Hey, Fein.
Irene. Getting used to traveling?
Yeah. Sort of.
I ask ＄＄＄＄＄＄ how you're doing now and then. I hear you're doing well.
Huh, really?
Well, I'm told you grumble, but you take responsibility and do a fine job.
Hmm, sounds like something she'd say. Well, I made up my mind, didn't I? So I have to do it.
Have you found out anything?
No, nothing...
I see...
But I'm sure we'll find some clue...
